correctness.rationale: Every maximal independent set has first selected vertex 1 or 2, successive gaps 2 or 3, and last selected vertex n-1 or n, yielding the exact signed recurrence. The unweighted count is odd except residues 2,3,5 modulo seven, so all Fourier multipliers are nonzero there. Integer matrix multiplication proves eB=e for the seven-site sign block; base zeros at lengths 2,3,5,9 give a zero in every remaining length. Exact brute-force Walsh transform for n=1..16 plus DP witnesses up to n=500 passed; the infinite proof is symbolic.

value.rationale: A complete infinite-family invertibility criterion for counting convolution on binary path-incidence cubes is a natural exact information-recovery invariant. The obstruction is not just the classical evenness of the unsigned Padovan count: an explicit seven-site integer transfer identity shows the required spectral zeros in every exceptional length. This is a structural classification with direct use for deciding recoverability, without claiming full nullity.
